Generated seccomp filter allowing write and fsync only for fd 2 or logfile_fd.

# Purpose
This generated header defines a seccomp BPF filter for the `fd_verify_tile` process and limits the system calls that the process can use. It checks the runtime architecture with `ARCH_NR`, then allows only `write` and `fsync` when they use the expected file descriptor values, including `2` for standard error and `logfile_fd` for the log file. All other system calls, or calls from an unsupported architecture, end with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_verify_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_verify_tile>) function fills a `sock_filter` array with the policy instructions, and the header guard prevents multiple inclusion in the build.
